test_name: Verify user registration via UI with valid data
preconditions: Browser is open on the Automation Exercise homepage (https://automationexercise.com). No existing account with the test email.
test_steps: Step 3: Enter a unique name (e.g., 'TestUser') and a valid email address (e.g., 'testuser_ui@example.com') in the 'New User Signup' section.
Step 5: Fill in the account information form with valid details (password: 'Test@123', date of birth, etc.).
Step 7: Verify the success message 'ACCOUNT CREATED!' is displayed.
expected_result: User is registered successfully and a success message 'ACCOUNT CREATED!' is shown. The user can log in with the new credentials.

test_name: Verify user registration via API with valid data
preconditions: API endpoint is accessible. No existing account with the test email.
test_steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to https://automationexercise.com/api/createAccount with form data: name='TestAPIUser', email='testuser_api@example.com', password='Test@123', title='Mr', birth_date='01', birth_month='01', birth_year='1990', firstname='Test', lastname='User', company='TestCo', address1='123 Test St', address2='Apt 4', country='United States', zipcode='12345', state='CA', city='Testville', mobile_number='1234567890'.
expected_result: Response code 201 and message 'User created successfully'.

test_name: Verify user login via UI with valid credentials
preconditions: A registered user account exists (e.g., testuser_ui@example.com / Test@123).
test_steps: Step 3: Enter the registered email and password in the 'Login to your account' section.
Step 5: Verify that the user is logged in and the username is displayed in the header.
expected_result: User is logged in successfully and the header shows 'Logged in as TestUser'.

test_name: Verify user login via UI with incorrect credentials
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page.
test_steps: Step 2: Enter an invalid email (e.g., 'wrong@example.com') and an invalid password (e.g., 'WrongPass').
expected_result: An error message 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is displayed and the user is not logged in.

test_name: Verify user login via API with valid credentials
preconditions: A registered user account exists (e.g., testuser_api@example.com / Test@123).
test_steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to https://automationexercise.com/api/verifyLogin with form data: email='testuser_api@example.com', password='Test@123'.

test_name: Verify user login via API with incorrect credentials
test_steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to https://automationexercise.com/api/verifyLogin with form data: email='wrong@example.com', password='WrongPass'.
expected_result: Response code 404 and message 'User not found!'.

test_name: Verify product search via UI with a valid keyword
preconditions: Browser is open on the homepage.
test_steps: Step 2: Locate the search bar at the top of the page.
Step 5: Verify that the search results page displays products related to the keyword.
expected_result: A list of products matching the search keyword is displayed, and the message 'Searched Products' is shown.

test_name: Verify product search via UI with an invalid keyword
preconditions: Browser is open on the homepage.
test_steps: Step 2: Enter a non-existent product keyword (e.g., 'xyzabc').
expected_result: No products are found and a message like 'No products found' or an empty product list is displayed.

test_name: Verify adding a product to cart via UI
preconditions: Browser is open on the homepage. A product is available.
test_steps: Step 2: Hover over the first product on the homepage.
Step 3: Click the 'Add to cart' button that appears.
Step 4: Click 'View Cart' in the modal that appears.
Step 5: Verify that the product is present in the cart with the correct quantity and price.
expected_result: The product is added to the cart and displayed in the cart page with correct details.

test_name: Verify checkout and place order via UI
preconditions: User is logged in and has at least one product in the cart.
test_steps: Step 1: Navigate to the cart page.
Step 3: Verify the delivery address and review the order.
Step 4: Enter a comment in the text area (optional).
Step 6: Fill in the payment details (name on card, card number, CVC, expiration).
Step 7: Click 'Pay and Confirm Order' button.
Step 8: Verify the success message 'Your order has been placed successfully!'.
expected_result: Order is placed successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.
